description: Get an email security fix plan for one domain: the exact SPF, DKIM and DMARC DNS records to publish (create / replace / keep, record name, value and why), in order, plus click-path steps for the domain's DNS host (Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Route 53, Namecheap, Squarespace/Google, Vercel and others). Reads live MX, NS, SPF, DKIM and DMARC; detects Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho, Proton, Fastmail, GoDaddy and Cloudflare Email Routing; merges SPF within the 10-lookup limit, keeps existing senders, and stages DMARC none -> quarantine -> reject. Domains that send no mail get a lock-down set. Use it when mail lands in spam, before a DMARC rollout, or for a client. DKIM keys are generated by the mail provider, so for those it gives the exact console path. Read-only; nothing is stored. Costs $1 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input, an unknown domain or a DNS failure returns an error and is not charged.

domain.description: Domain to fix, e.g. example.com (an email address or URL on it also works)
